notes: IKEA Japan (jp/ja market), same global IKEA platform as UK/DE/FR/AE siblings from the prior Home-Decor pass. Access: tier-1 direct HTTP fetch worked cleanly throughout (HTTP 200, no WAF/CAPTCHA, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow -- robots.txt only has 'Disallow: */search/?q=*' for User-agent: *); no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. Navigation discovery: checked homepage main nav/mega-menu, footer, the /offers/ (お買い得商品/Deals) landing page, and direct URL-shape probing on IKEA's known /cat/<slug>/ category scheme (same scheme documented in notes/184.md for the 58 shared Home-Decor category IDs). Found the homepage surfaces a '人気商品' (Popular Products) widget captioned '2026年上半期の人気アイテム' (Popular items of H1 2026) that links through to a real category page. Verified the candidate at https://www.ikea.com/jp/ja/cat/best-sellers/ (canonical) is a genuine PLP: page <title> '人気商品 - IKEA', meta description 'イケア公式通販サイトの人気商品の一覧ページです...' (this is IKEA's official popular-products listing page), embedded hierarchyObjs shows type:'cat', parent:'root' (a real top-level category node in IKEA's taxonomy, same tier as ordinary product categories), and subCategories:[] confirms no genuine site-exposed sub-structure -- a single flat listing, not a grouping. Also cross-checked the site's own translation key 'T_OFFERS_TYPE_TOP_SELLER':'人気商品' elsewhere on the homepage, confirming '人気商品' is IKEA's own site-wide label for the Top-Seller/Bestseller concept (not my inference). No separate /cat/bestsellers/ (404) or /cat/popular-products/ (redirects to the generic all-products page, not valid) exist -- only /cat/best-sellers/ is real. Search terms checked: 人気商品, 売れ筋 (0 hits site-wide on homepage), ベストセラー (0 hits). Qty verified two independent ways on the same fetch: rendered ARIA product-count text '726アイテム' (726 items) and embedded JSON 'totalCount':726 -- both agree.
